title: wolfhsm 'uds' feature needs posixTransportUds (lost wolfHSM fork)
description: posixTransportUds_* existed only in the user's local wolfHSM fork (WOLFHSM_SRC on the lost machine). Upstream wolfHSM at the pinned 2d61571 lacks it, so --features uds doesn't build. Either re-create the fork, upstream the transport, or drop the feature.
